name: com.leonidalab/gta6-facts
title: Leonida Lab: GTA 6 facts, official or not
description: Unofficial GTA 6 facts and database, with status. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.

tools.name: check_claim
tools.description: Checks one claim about GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI) against the record: a PC version, 60 FPS, the frame rate, online at launch, a disc, crossplay, early access, map size, story length, age rating, microtransactions and more. Returns the closest matches, each with its status (official, reported or not announced), the detail and the page to cite. A miss lists the topics that are covered. Unofficial: Leonida Lab is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.

query.description: The claim or topic in a few words: "PC version", "60 FPS on PS5 Pro", "is there a disc", "online at launch".

tools.name: release_info
tools.description: When GTA 6 comes out: the official date (November 19, 2026), the platforms and which are not announced, the unlock time in each of 15 regions or in the one place you name, and the dates around launch (boxed copies and preload, the pre-order deadline). Each part carries its own status: the unlock hour is not necessarily official, and the answer says which. Unofficial: not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.

place.description: A country, region, city or IANA time zone for the unlock time: "Germany", "US West", "Tokyo", "Europe/Rome". Omit it for every region.

tools.name: price_in_country
tools.description: What a buyer pays for GTA 6 in one of 63 markets, Standard and Ultimate, read from the official PlayStation Store and Xbox Store listings: the price at checkout in local currency, its US dollar value at the official exchange rate, and whether tax is inside the price, added at checkout or unconfirmed. A price listed before tax is labelled and is never called cheaper. Unofficial: not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.

country.description: A country by name or two-letter code: "Brazil", "UK", "Japan", "DE".

platform.description: Only this store. Omit it for both.

tools.name: compare_editions
tools.description: The two GTA 6 editions side by side: US list prices, what each includes, every Ultimate Edition bonus as Rockstar lists it, the pre-order bonus and its deadline, the fact that there is no disc (boxed copies hold a download code), and the Collector's Box, which is merchandise without the game. Each line carries its status. Unofficial: not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Dated entries from the Leonida Lab changelog, newest first: what Rockstar Games, Take-Two or the stores announced, other news about the game, and changes to the site itself, each labelled. Optionally only entries since a date. Unofficial: not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.

since.description: Only entries on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: search_database
tools.description: Searches the Leonida Lab database of the released game, GTA 6 (Grand Theft Auto VI): the answers to what players ask (how to save, how to lose the police), vehicles, weapons, animals, safes and locks with their codes, radio stations, cheat codes, controls, ways to make money, trophies and the 100% list. The kind argument takes answer, vehicle, weapon, animal, safe, radio, cheat, control, money, trophy, completion. Every hit has a one-line answer and the page to cite, and, except a story spoiler, its status (Confirmed, Confirmed in the released game or Not confirmed yet); a story spoiler is flagged and never summarised, and has no status. Call get_entry for the whole row. A miss lists what is covered, and says when story answers are held back. Unofficial: Leonida Lab is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.

query.description: What you want to know, in a few words: "how do I save", "lose the police", "keep a stolen car".

kind.description: Only this kind of entry. Omit it to search every kind.

tools.name: get_entry
tools.description: The whole row of one Leonida Lab database entry, by the kind and slug that search_database returns: what its page states, its status and the page to cite. A hidden trophy is kind trophy with the slug hidden-<number> (no search lists one) and gives its number, grade and score. An entry that gives part of the story away returns only its flag and its page. Unofficial: Leonida Lab is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.

kind.description: The kind of the entry, as search_database gives it.

slug.description: The slug of the entry, as search_database gives it.
